create_idefics3_image_processor: create an Idefics3ImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the Idefics3 multimodal model
preprocess_images_for_idefics3: preprocess a batch of images into pixel values and attention masks for the Idefics3 model
split_large_images_into_patches: split a large image into overlapping patches of max_image_size with the original image for higher resolution processing
resize_images_for_vision_encoder: resize images to multiples of vision_encoder_max_size while preserving aspect ratio for the vision encoder
pad_images_to_uniform_size: pad images to a uniform padded size and generate a pixel attention mask indicating valid pixels
